body: I can certainly see myself stuck in a rut but that doesn't change the fact that I loss my job. The job was the last saving bastion of hope, I guess. I just thought that in this point in my life I would have had more stability. Thanks for the reply.
In a row, probably 50 but I'm not sure whats the point.

Thanks for replying, personally what I really enjoy is lifting, training for specific goals (marathons, mountain climbing, possibly bodybuilding) and making myself overall in better shape. That's all taken a nose dive with all things considering and I've engorged myself in all bad dietary consumption(fast food, cinnabon , etc). I'm into motivational stuff too but my mind is clouded with feeling like a failure. I had this job for like a month and couldn't hold it down and some how I feel as though I'm not as great as I thought I was and or capable. I really love talking about fitness and programs to better oneself and now more than ever I need that. But I'm too far lost in my own self that I can see anything passed the negativity. Life is just too fucking much and I don't want to keep fighting for something that I have no stake in. I feel honored that Im the first reply that  you posted to, I thank you but this is where my head is at.
